thread:
sarah_sales: Heads-up team — Product is shipping a rate card change next week introducing a staggered-commit policy. Full doc: https://redwood.internal/pricing/ratecard-v2026.2 (TL;DR below). We need to flag any live opportunities that this will affect and decide grandfathering. :warning:

ajay_pricing: Thanks Sarah. Quick recap for the channel — commits >25% discount will require a 3-month vest period, and the minimum commit size increases to $25k/mo. Smaller deals unchanged.

noah_revenueops: What's the formal approval path for exceptions? Deal Desk still? Any new approval thresholds?

ajay_pricing: Yep — Deal Desk for any exception to the vesting or to shave >5% off the published cap. New threshold: any proposed discount >20% or commit modifications for deals >$50k go to Deal Desk (deal-desk@).

meera_legal: We need plain-language contract language for the vesting clause. I'll draft a short amendment. Will the finance team want prorated invoicing for partial vest months?

lucy_salesops: Flagging process request: can we get a CSV export of all active opps >$10k ARR so AE managers can triage? I can run it if ProdOps gives access. Prefer to catch pipeline before renewal windows.

pricing-bot: Automated notice: ratecard v2026.2 scheduled for deployment 2026-06-08 08:00 UTC. Old ratecard will be archived but accessible.

ajay_pricing: Proposed internal comms blurb for AEs (please edit):
```
Heads up — starting 2026-06-08, we are switching to a staggered commit discount policy for qualifying committed capacity. For quotes over $25k/month where discounts exceed 25%, discounts will vest monthly over 3 months instead of up-front. Existing signed contracts prior to 2026-06-01 will be grandfathered. If you have a pipeline deal that might be impacted, add tag #ratecard-v2026.2 and notify deal-desk.
```

noah_revenueops: +1 to the tag. Also ask AEs to add estimated start date to the deal fields — we need to know if a customer expects immediate credits.

meera_legal: Draft note for contracts: we should add a one-sentence amendment to SOWs: "Discounts tied to committed capacity may be applied pro rata over a defined vesting period as specified in the applicable rate card." I'll circulate a tracked change.

lucy_salesops: To reduce friction, suggest a grace window for closed-won deals executed in the next two weeks — auto-grandfather them if signed before 2026-06-01 23:59 UTC. Can finance handle exceptions after that?

ajay_pricing: Finance confirmed they can handle one-off exceptions but want Deal Desk sign-off and a short approval note stored in SFDC (reason + approver).

sarah_sales: Action items: 1) AEs — tag deals >$50k and add start date; 2) Deal Desk — be ready for exceptions and update SFDC approval field; 3) Legal — circulate amendment; 4) SalesOps — run CSV and triage. I'll post a short announcement to #sales in 1h. Anyone needs to be looped in?

meera_legal: FYI loop in customer success for renewal conversations.

pricing-bot: Reminder: update quote templates under /templates/pricing before 2026-06-08 to reflect new vesting verbiage.

ajay_pricing: I'll update the public ratecard PDF and put a changelog note. Also will prepare a one-pager for AE playbook (how to explain staggered vesting to customers).

sarah_sales: Perfect — thanks all. If any AE finds a stuck deal with potential >25% discount appetite ping me directly. :thumbsup:
